card.text: Explore Mimas in 3D with cssEarth. Inspect Cassini imagery of Saturn’s cratered moon and its giant Herschel impact basin.

introduction.text: A small, icy moon of Saturn dominated by Herschel crater, a giant impact scar spanning roughly a third of its diameter.

normal.title: Monochrome mosaic
normal.summary: Source pixels span 216 m in the 2017 mosaic. Photographed shadows remain; the displayed shape is a simplified model.

enhanced.title: Enhanced-color composite
enhanced.summary: Infrared, green and ultraviolet bands reveal colors beyond human vision. Detail varies; photographed shading and seams remain.

elevation.title: SPC terrain model
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 198.2 km sphere, from Cassini's shape model. It includes Mimas's oval shape; gray grid: no data.
